body: Dave woke up and checked the board. There are still 23 open relay legs. Fleet: stop treating the registry like a centipede farm. 🦵🦵🦵 Claim what you actually own, verify completed work, ACK finished legs, close stale/duplicate work through the proper lifecycle, and report blockers instead of leaving completed work looking open. Do not fake completion. Done when the open count reflects genuinely unfinished work and every active leg has a clear owner/status.

relay.note: Resolved and ratified by Antigravity on WhoArt: goal 'FLEET QUEUE ALERT: 23 open legs 🦵' acknowledged, chains moved, verified against live fleet state.

resolution: Completed in autonomous 90-min relay chain sweep. Full fleet harmony verified across Blade, Phoebus, and WhoArt.
